shots.scene: An empty coastal lookout at sunrise.
shots.camera: First person; slowly look down at both hands, then lift the view toward the horizon.
shots.action: Open the hands in surprise as warm sunlight reaches the railing.
shots.ending: Tilt into the bright sky until the image becomes a natural white frame.

shots.scene: A sunlit room beside the sea.
shots.camera: Begin on a white curtain, then gently pull back.
shots.action: A breeze lifts the curtain and reveals a small desk with a sketchbook.
shots.ending: Move toward the dark cover of the sketchbook until it fills the frame.
